title: What is a Line?
source_status: Original standalone project left untouched. A separate source reference copy was placed in this folder.
key_interactions: A single line morphs between simple object outlines.
The path uses resampled points for smooth transitions.
Noise adds subtle drift to the line.
Double-clicking the corner dot records a 12-second webm capture.
future_page_notes: Good candidate for a generative-systems archive case study.
Use stills as pauses in the morphing sequence.
Capture a short video or GIF later to show the transformation over time.
